stories.headline: Anthropic signs 12+ data center lease LOIs covering 1+ GW, seeks Google financial guarantee

key_facts.fact: Anthropic has signed more than a dozen preliminary agreements to lease US data centers with combined capacity exceeding 1 gigawatt.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic, the creator of the Claude Code AI assistant, has signed more than a dozen preliminary agreements to lease U.S. data centers with a combined capacity of more than 1 GW, The Information reported, citing sources with direct knowledge of the plans.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic executives discussed having Google provide a financial guarantee on the lease payments, building on Google's role co-designing the server chips Anthropic would use.
key_facts.excerpt: The AI startup's executives have also discussed an arrangement under which backer Google, which co-designs some of the server chips Anthropic could use in the facilities, would provide a financial guarantee for its lease payments.

key_facts.fact: Google declined to comment on the discussions and Anthropic did not immediately respond.
key_facts.excerpt: In an emailed response, Google said it does not comment on rumors or speculation, while Anthropic did not immediately respond to Reuters' request for comment.

key_facts.fact: Apollo Global Management and Blackstone are providing private credit as part of the wider financing structure tied to Anthropic compute.
key_facts.excerpt: Executives at the company have also reportedly discussed an arrangement where Google would financially backstop those lease payments, with Apollo Global Management and Blackstone providing private credit as part of the wider financing structure.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic raised $65 billion in late May at a $965 billion post-money valuation and filed confidentially for a US IPO earlier this month.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic last raised funds in late May, securing $65 billion at a post-money valuation of $965 billion, placing it ahead of OpenAI... Anthropic announced that it had confidentially filed for a U.S. IPO.

key_facts.fact: Google had earlier announced plans to invest up to $40 billion in Anthropic.
key_facts.excerpt: In April, the AI startup said that Alphabet planned to invest up to $40 billion in Anthropic.

stories.headline: Bezos' Prometheus raises $12B Series B at $41B valuation for 'artificial general engineer'

key_facts.excerpt: Prometheus, the physical AI startup co-founded by Jeff Bezos and Vik Bajaj, the former co-founder of Verily, Google's life sciences unit, announced it raised $12 billion at a $41 billion valuation.

key_facts.fact: Investors include JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, BlackRock, DST Global and Arch Venture Partners; Bezos contributed again after being the largest backer of the $6.2B Series A.
key_facts.excerpt: Investors in the round include JPMorgan, BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, DST Global and Arch Venture Partners, according to Axios. Bezos was the largest backer of the company's $6.2 billion Series A, and he said in a CNBC interview at the company's San Francisco headquarters that he participated in the new round as well.

key_facts.fact: Prometheus launched in November 2025 with $6.2B in seed funding; total funding now exceeds $18B in less than a year.
key_facts.excerpt: Bezos, who was the largest backer of the company's $6.2B Series A at launch in November 2025, contributed again in this round... pushing its valuation to $41B and total funding past $18B in less than a year of existence.

key_facts.fact: Prometheus is building what Bezos calls an 'artificial general engineer' — AI tools to compress the design-to-manufacturing cycle for physical products from years to months.
key_facts.excerpt: The physical AI startup, co-led by Jeff Bezos and Vik Bajaj, is building what it calls an 'artificial general engineer:' AI tools to compress the design-to-manufacturing cycle for physical products from years to months

key_facts.fact: The company employs about 150 people across San Francisco, London and Zurich and has not disclosed any commercial revenue.
key_facts.excerpt: Prometheus has 150 staff across San Francisco, London, and Zurich and has not yet disclosed commercial revenue

key_facts.fact: A large portion of the capital will go toward compute, with Bezos saying the work is 'very compute intensive,' especially for data generation; the startup has poached employees from OpenAI, Google DeepMind and Nvidia.

stories.headline: Crusoe pushed out of 1.8GW Wyoming AI data center after Google raised cost and timing concerns

key_facts.fact: Crusoe paused work on Project Jade, a 1.8GW data center campus planned in Cheyenne, Wyoming, that was designed to scale up to 10GW.
key_facts.excerpt: Data center developer Crusoe has paused work on Project Jade, a massive campus planned for Cheyenne, Wyoming. The 1.8GW facility was announced last year, with claims it could scale to 10GW.

key_facts.fact: Bloomberg reported that Google raised concerns about costs and the construction timetable under Crusoe's management, leading the company to leave the project.
key_facts.excerpt: Bloomberg reported that Google raised concerns about costs and the construction timetable under Crusoe's management, and the company was pressured to leave. A Crusoe spokesperson told Bloomberg the company did not have a signed agreement with the prospective customer but had entered into exclusive talks.

key_facts.fact: Crusoe said it has contracted 4.9GW of data center infrastructure for Crusoe Cloud outside Wyoming, with a total pipeline exceeding 40GW.
key_facts.excerpt: At the same time, Crusoe said that it has contracted 4.9GW of data center infrastructure for Crusoe Cloud. It claimed that its total development pipeline - including contracted projects, sites under active tenant negotiation, and sites in advanced development – exceeds 40GW.

key_facts.fact: Crusoe is valued at $10 billion and counts Nvidia, Salesforce and Mubadala Capital among its backers.
key_facts.excerpt: Crusoe, the AI infrastructure company valued at $10 billion, is being pushed out of Project Jade... Its backers include Nvidia, Salesforce, and Mubadala Capital.

key_facts.fact: Tallgrass, Crusoe's energy partner on Project Jade and backed by Blackstone, confirmed Crusoe demobilized from the site months ago and is in talks with other AI infrastructure companies to replace it.
key_facts.excerpt: Tallgrass also confirmed that Crusoe 'demobilized and moved off the site' several months ago... Tallgrass has been working with other AI infrastructure companies to replace Crusoe that have not yet been announced.

key_facts.fact: Crusoe's flagship Abilene, Texas campus has had reliability issues, with buildings going offline for days due to winter weather affecting liquid cooling, and Oracle and OpenAI declined to lease additional capacity there.
key_facts.excerpt: Bloomberg reported that at the company's Abilene, Texas site, Oracle and OpenAI decided not to lease additional capacity, and the campus experienced reliability issues, including buildings going offline for days due to winter weather affecting liquid cooling machinery.

stories.headline: Google taps Samsung for Icefish TPU memory I/O die as TSMC capacity tightens

key_facts.fact: Google is in talks to outsource production of the memory input/output die for its 10th-generation TPU, codenamed Icefish, to Samsung's 2-nanometer foundry process.
key_facts.excerpt: Google is in talks to outsource production of the memory I/O Die — a key component connecting the computing unit and HBM in the 10th-generation TPU (code-named Ice Fish) — to Samsung Electronics' 2-nanometer process.

key_facts.fact: TSMC will continue to manufacture the TPU's core computing engine, expected to use its 1.4-nanometer process.
key_facts.excerpt: Google plans to produce the core computing chip at TSMC's 1.4-nanometer process, while Samsung is expected to manufacture the memory input/output die (I/O Die)—a critical component connecting the core chip with high-bandwidth memory (HBM)—using its 2-nanometer process.

key_facts.fact: The split-foundry strategy reflects TSMC's saturated capacity for AI chips and Google's desire to lock in Samsung HBM supply.
key_facts.excerpt: As TSMC's supply chain bottleneck deepens, Google has turned its attention to Samsung Electronics' 'comprehensive semiconductor solution,' which encompasses HBM, advanced processes, and packaging capabilities... Some analysts also suggest that Google is seeking to secure a head start on HBM, which is in short supply, by using foundry orders as leverage.

key_facts.fact: Samsung has supplied more than 60% of the HBM used in Google's TPUs over the past year.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung supplying more than 60% of the HBM for Google's TPUs last year.

key_facts.fact: Icefish is expected to enter mass production as early as 2028, with discussions still in early stages.
key_facts.excerpt: 'The 10th-generation TPU is expected to enter mass production as early as 2028, and current discussions are in their early stages,' a semiconductor industry official said.

key_facts.fact: Google is also reportedly in talks with Intel for some TPU components, in addition to Samsung.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electronics is expected to take on a portion of the production for Google's next-generation artificial intelligence (AI) chip. Google is also reportedly in negotiations with Intel.

stories.headline: J&J's IMAAVY shows durable hemoglobin response in pivotal wAIHA trial at EHA Congress

key_facts.fact: Johnson & Johnson on June 11 presented the first comprehensive Phase 2/3 ENERGY results at the EHA 2026 Congress in Stockholm showing IMAAVY (nipocalimab-aahu) produced a statistically significant durable hemoglobin response in warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia (wAIHA)
key_facts.excerpt: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ) today is presenting the first comprehensive results from the Phase 2/3 ENERGY study showing that IMAAVY® (nipocalimab-aahu) produced a statistically significant durable hemoglobin (Hgb) response with rapid onset of effect in patients with warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia (wAIHA) in the 30 mg/kg treatment group, compared with those who received placebo.

key_facts.fact: In the 30 mg/kg arm, mean hemoglobin improved by at least 1 g/dL as early as Week 1; about three times as many patients achieved durable Hgb levels versus placebo by Week 24, and nearly two-thirds hit both ≥10 g/dL and ≥2 g/dL increase targets
key_facts.excerpt: The randomized, placebo-controlled trial demonstrated approximately three times as many patients achieved durable Hgb levels versus placebo by 24 weeks. Overall, patients treated with this dose of IMAAVY showed a mean Hgb improvement of at least 1g/dL as early as Week 1.

key_facts.fact: Warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia (wAIHA) is a rare, life-threatening autoantibody-driven condition with no FDA-approved treatment; the data support a supplemental BLA that the FDA granted Priority Review in Q2 2026
key_facts.excerpt: To be presented at the European Hematology Association (EHA) 2026 Congress, these results mark an important step forward for people living with wAIHA, a rare, life-threatening condition for which patients currently have no U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA)-approved treatment options... These data support the supplemental Biologics License Application (sBLA) for IMAAVY which has since been granted U.S. FDA Priority Review.

key_facts.fact: IMAAVY is designed to target pathogenic IgG autoantibodies that destroy red blood cells in wAIHA while preserving broader immune function; the abstract (S300) was presented June 11, 16:45-18:00 CEST
key_facts.excerpt: NIPOCALIMAB FOR WARM AUTOIMMUNE HEMOLYTIC ANEMIA: RESULTS FROM THE... - Fattizzo B - EHA-3412 - Jun 11 2026

stories.headline: KKR launches Helix Digital Infrastructure with $10B+ from Kuwait, Nvidia and Vistra

key_facts.fact: KKR, the Kuwait Investment Authority, Nvidia and Vistra launched Helix Digital Infrastructure with more than $10 billion of committed capital to build AI data centers, power and connectivity.
key_facts.excerpt: KKR, together with the Kuwait Investment Authority (KIA), NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) and Vistra (NYSE: VST) today announced the launch of Helix Digital Infrastructure ('Helix')... the Helix strategy has more than $10 billion in total long-duration capital commitments to date.

key_facts.fact: Helix will be led by former AWS chief Adam Selipsky, with KKR's global head of digital infrastructure Waldemar Szlezak as chief investment officer.
key_facts.excerpt: The company will be led by former Amazon Web Services CEO Adam Selipsky, while KKR's Global Head of Digital Infrastructure, Waldemar Szlezak, will serve as chief investment officer.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia will be a cornerstone strategic partner, supplying its DSX AI-factory architecture; Vistra will be Helix's preferred power provider.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA will also serve as a strategic partner to support the deployment of NVIDIA DSX AI factory-aligned infrastructure with a view to maximizing tokens per watt, achieving lowest total cost of ownership and accelerating time to first token... Vistra, a leading integrated power generation and electricity company with operations across 18 states and Washington, D.C., will be the preferred power provider for Helix investments.

key_facts.fact: Helix sits inside KKR's infrastructure business, which manages more than $100 billion globally and has invested over $70 billion in digital infrastructure and power.
key_facts.excerpt: The initiative is backed by KKR's infrastructure business, which manages more than $100 billion in infrastructure assets globally and has invested over $70 billion across digital infrastructure and power-related sectors.

key_facts.fact: The launch follows Apollo and Blackstone's recently announced $35 billion private credit program linked to Anthropic projects.
key_facts.excerpt: The launch of Helix is part of a broader trend of private capital mobilization around artificial intelligence infrastructure. The rising cost of data centers and computing capacity is attracting numerous financial players, similar to Apollo and Blackstone, which recently announced a $35bn program linked to Anthropic projects.

stories.headline: FDA grants Priority Review to Roche's Tecentriq combo for stage III dMMR colon cancer

key_facts.fact: On June 11 Roche said the FDA accepted its sBLA for adjuvant Tecentriq (atezolizumab) and Tecentriq Hybreza plus FOLFOX6 chemotherapy in stage III deficient DNA mismatch repair (dMMR)/MSI-H colon cancer, granting Priority Review with a decision expected by October 9, 2026
key_facts.excerpt: Basel, 11 June 2026 - Roche (SIX: RO, ROP; OTCQX: RHHBY) announced today that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has accepted the company's supplemental Biologics License Application (sBLA) filing for adjuvant Tecentriq® (atezolizumab) and Tecentriq Hybreza® (atezolizumab and hyaluronidase-tqjs) in combination with chemotherapy in stage III deficient DNA mismatch repair (dMMR) or microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) colon cancer... The FDA has granted Priority Review and is expected to make a decision on the approval by 9 October 2026.

key_facts.fact: Filing rests on the Phase 3 ATOMIC study (712 patients), recently published in The New England Journal of Medicine, showing the Tecentriq-FOLFOX6 combination reduced the risk of disease recurrence or death by 50% vs chemotherapy alone
key_facts.excerpt: The application is based on the landmark ATOMIC study, recently published in The New England Journal of Medicine. ATOMIC demonstrated that adding Tecentriq to standard FOLFOX6 chemotherapy reduced the risk of disease recurrence or death by 50%, compared to chemotherapy alone for people with stage III dMMR colon cancer.

key_facts.fact: 36-month disease-free survival was 86% in the Tecentriq+FOLFOX6 arm versus 76% with FOLFOX6 alone; safety was consistent with previous Tecentriq studies
key_facts.excerpt: The 36-month disease-free survival was 86% for Tecentriq combined with FOLFOX6 compared with 76% in the FOLFOX6 alone group. The safety profile was consistent with previous studies of Tecentriq and FOLFOX6.

key_facts.fact: Separately on June 11, Guardant Health said the FDA approved Guardant360 CDx as a companion diagnostic for Boehringer Ingelheim's Hernexeos (zongertinib), the first targeted therapy for HER2-mutant advanced non-small cell lung cancer
key_facts.excerpt: Guardant Health, Inc. stories.headline: SpaceX prices largest-ever IPO at $135/share, raising $75B at $1.77T valuation

key_facts.fact: SpaceX priced its IPO at $135 per share on June 11, selling 555.6 million shares to raise about $75 billion, the biggest-ever U.S. IPO and topping Saudi Aramco's $25.6B 2019 deal
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX on June 11 priced the biggest-ever US initial public offering at US$135 a share... The IPO raised a record US$75 billion on the sale of 555.56 million shares, valuing the space, satellite and AI provider at US$1.77 trillion.

key_facts.fact: The $135 price implies a fully diluted valuation of about $1.77 trillion, making SpaceX the seventh-largest publicly traded U.S. company and worth more than Tesla (~$1.6T)
key_facts.excerpt: The $135 share price values SpaceX at $1.77 trillion ahead of its debut on the Nasdaq on Friday, making it the seventh-largest publicly traded company in the U.S. in terms of market capitalization.

key_facts.fact: Musk keeps 82.4% of voting power through 5.22 billion Class B shares; underwriters have an option for 83.33M more shares ($11.2B) within 30 days
key_facts.excerpt: Underwriters have the option to buy an additional 83.33 million shares at the IPO price in the next few days, amounting to an additional $11.2 billion. The sale leaves Musk with 82.4% of the company's total voting power through his ownership of 5.22 billion Class B shares.

key_facts.fact: SpaceX targeted retail investors for ~30% of the offering — about $22.5 billion — versus a typical 5%-10%; the IPO was more than four times oversubscribed
key_facts.excerpt: SPACEX's initial public offering has attracted demand for more than four times the available shares... The company is offering 555.6 million shares at a fixed price of US$135 each, which would raise about US$75 billion, and value it at about US$1.8 trillion.

key_facts.fact: SpaceX generated about $18.7B in revenue in 2025 but posted an operating loss of $4.2B; it begins trading June 12 on Nasdaq under ticker SPCX
key_facts.excerpt: Heading into its abbreviated roadshow last week, the company said $135 is the share price and $1.77 trillion is the anticipated market cap. That's for a company that generated $18.7 billion in revenue last year and recorded an operating loss of $4.2 billion.

key_facts.fact: Lead underwriters are Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, Citigroup and JPMorgan Chase, with 18 other banks participating
key_facts.excerpt: Goldman Sachs Group, Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, Citigroup and JPMorgan Chase are leading the deal, with 18 other banks participating.

stories.headline: Barcelona's Theker raises $85M Series A from CRV, Samsung and LVMH for AI factory robots

key_facts.fact: Barcelona-based AI robotics company Theker raised $85 million (€73M) in a Series A led by CRV.
key_facts.excerpt: THEKER, the Barcelona-based AI robotics company, has raised €73 million($85 million) in a Series A to scale its generalist factory robots across industrial production environments. The round was led by CRV

key_facts.fact: The round marks Samsung's first-ever investment in a Spanish company, LVMH's first bet on the Spanish startup ecosystem, and one of CRV's first investments in Spain.
key_facts.excerpt: It marks Samsung's first-ever investment in a Spanish company, LVMH's first bet on the Spanish startup ecosystem, and CRV's first investment in Spain.

key_facts.fact: Other participants include Cathay Innovation, 20VC, Henkel Ventures, Korelya, Bright Pixel Capital (Sonae), and existing investors Inditex, Kfund and Kibo Ventures.
key_facts.excerpt: Cathay Innovation, 20VC, Henkel Ventures, Korelya and Bright Pixel Capital also backed the fundraise, in addition to historical investors including Spanish retailer Inditex and VCs Kfund and Kibo Ventures.

key_facts.fact: Theker calls its round the largest robotics Series A ever raised in Europe.
key_facts.excerpt: THEKER, the Barcelona-based AI robotics company building AI-native generalist robots for industrial production environments, today announced a $85 million round, making it the largest robotics Series A round ever raised in Europe.

key_facts.fact: Founded in 2022 by Carla Gómez Cano and Jiaqiang Ye Zhu, Theker builds AI-native generalist robots that adapt in real time to mixed SKUs, irregular shapes and operational variability without manual reprogramming.
key_facts.excerpt: Founded by robotics and AI engineers Carla Gómez Cano and Jiaqiang Ye Zhu, THEKER is building a new category of industrial robotics: AI-native generalist robots capable of adapting in real time to changing environments, mixed SKUs, irregular shapes and operational variability without manual reprogramming.

key_facts.fact: Theker is already deploying its robots in industrial settings — for example, working with Inditex to automate tasks in the retailer's logistics operations.
key_facts.excerpt: The systems are suited to industrial settings in fields like waste management, logistics, food, manufacturing and retail. Theker says it is already deploying its robots in real-world production environments; the startup is working with Inditex, for instance, to automate tasks in the retailer's logistics operations.

stories.headline: Trump cancels Iran strikes after two-day exchange, claims imminent deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz

key_facts.fact: On June 11, Trump posted on Truth Social that he had cancelled scheduled U.S. strikes on Iran after discussions reached 'the highest level of Iranian leadership' and were approved
key_facts.excerpt: U.S. President Donald Trump said Thursday he had called off new military strikes on Iran, suggesting progress had been made in talks to end the war just hours after the American leader threatened to escalate the conflict by seizing control of Iran's oil industry.

key_facts.fact: Trump's reversal came hours after he warned the U.S. would hit Iran 'VERY HARD TONIGHT' and threatened to take 'total control' of Iran's oil and gas industries, including the Kharg Island oil terminal
key_facts.excerpt: Trump's announcement marked a sharp shift in tone after he earlier warned that US forces would strike Iran 'VERY HARD TONIGHT' and suggested Washington could seize control of Kharg Island, the Gulf terminal through which most Iranian oil exports pass.

key_facts.fact: Trump said the draft framework would extend the ceasefire, reopen the Strait of Hormuz and launch 60 days of negotiations on Iran's nuclear program, with a signing potentially in Europe over the weekend led by VP Vance
key_facts.excerpt: Washington (United States) (AFP) – US President Donald Trump withdrew his threat to launch a more devastating wave of bombings against Iran on Thursday and promised instead that he would soon be able to announce the signing of a deal with Tehran to end the war.

key_facts.fact: The pivot followed two consecutive days of strikes: the U.S. fired 49 Tomahawk missiles at targets near Tehran while Iran's IRGC launched 12 ballistic missiles at Jordan's Al-Azraq/Muwaffaq Salti air base and claimed strikes on 18 U.S. targets in Kuwait and Bahrain
key_facts.excerpt: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said it fired 12 ballistic missiles at Jordan's Muwaffaq Salti Air Base, where US fighter jets are stationed, and claimed strikes on 18 American military targets in Kuwait and Bahrain, as well as a base in Erbil, Iraqi Kurdistan.

key_facts.fact: Iran's foreign ministry tempered Trump's claim, saying 'so far, Iran has not reached a final conclusion on the agreement'; semi-official Tasnim noted Trump had publicly declared a deal imminent 38 times in the prior two months
key_facts.excerpt: Iran on Friday tempered expectations, with foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei saying: 'So far, Iran has not reached a final conclusion on the agreement'. The semi-official Tasnim news agency also noted that Trump had publicly announced a deal was imminent 38 times in the previous two months.

key_facts.fact: Trump said the U.S. naval blockade would 'remain in full force and effect until this Transaction is finalized' and that Iran would agree never to have a nuclear weapon
key_facts.excerpt: 'The Naval Blockade will remain in full force and effect until this Transaction is finalized — Time and place of the signing to be announced shortly,' he said.

stories.headline: Ukraine downs 102 of 117 Russian drones overnight as Shahed attacks continue

key_facts.fact: On the night of June 11-12, Russia attacked Ukraine with 117 Shahed-type, Gerbera, Italmas and Parodiya decoy strike UAVs, launched from Orel, Kursk, Millerovo and occupied Crimea
key_facts.excerpt: On the night of June 12, Russia launched 117 strike UAVs of various types against Ukraine. Air defense destroyed 102 drones, with hits recorded at seven locations.

key_facts.fact: Ukrainian air defense neutralized 102 of the 117 drones; 14 strike UAVs hit seven locations and debris fell at eight more, with several enemy UAVs still in airspace as of 08:00
key_facts.excerpt: Air defense forces shot down 102 of the 117 drones with which the Russian invaders attacked Ukraine since the evening of June 11... There were hits by 14 strike UAVs at seven locations, and debris from downed drones fell at eight locations.

key_facts.fact: Ukrainian commander Oleksandr Syrskyi said on June 11 that Ukrainian FPV drones now outnumber Russian FPVs on the battlefield by an unspecified ratio that 'is growing'

stories.headline: Xiaomi open-sources MiMo Code V0.1.0, claims edge over Claude Code on long-horizon tasks

key_facts.fact: Xiaomi's MiMo AI team open-sourced MiMo Code V0.1.0, a terminal-native AI coding assistant, claiming it outperforms Anthropic's Claude Code on agentic coding benchmarks.
key_facts.excerpt: Xiaomi's MiMo AI team has open-sourced MiMo Code V0.1.0, a terminal-native AI coding assistant that the Chinese electronics giant says outperforms Anthropic's Claude Code on key agentic coding benchmarks, especially on long-horizon, multi-step tasks (200+ steps)

key_facts.fact: Running the same MiMo-V2.5-Pro model in both harnesses, MiMo Code scored 62% on SWE-Bench Pro versus 57% for Claude Code, and 73% on Terminal Bench 2 versus 68% for Claude Code.
key_facts.excerpt: Running the same MiMo-V2.5-Pro model in both harnesses, MiMo Code scored 62% on SWE-bench Pro versus 57% for Claude Code, and 73% on Terminal Bench 2 versus 68% — roughly five points each, attributable purely to the agent system rather than the model.

key_facts.fact: In a double-blind A/B evaluation with 576 developers across 474 private repositories, MiMo Code's win rate rose above 65% past 200 execution steps, while the two systems split roughly 50/50 under 200 steps.
key_facts.excerpt: During the reporting period, the internal beta covered 576 developers and 474 real private repositories, producing 1,213 A/B pairs with clear win/loss judgments... when the number of execution steps is within 200, the win rates of the two systems are close to 50%; when the number of steps exceeds 200 (including multi-turn user interaction), MiMo Code's win rate rises to over 65%.

key_facts.fact: MiMo Code is a fork of the open-source OpenCode project, released under the MIT license, and ships with free access to MiMo V2.5 with a 1-million-token context window.
key_facts.excerpt: MiMo Code V0.1 is open-source and built as a fork of OpenCode, extending it with persistent memory, multi-agent orchestration, and context management capabilities... MiMo V2.5 multimodal model with 1M token context window, free for a limited time

key_facts.fact: MiMo Code supports importing existing Claude Code configurations in one step and connecting to providers including Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM.
key_facts.excerpt: Claude Code compatibility with automatic loading of skills, MCP servers, and commands - Support for multiple model providers including Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Kimi, and GLM

key_facts.fact: The GitHub repository was created on June 10, 2026 and tagged its v0.1.0 release the same day.
